currency.quote: The money in your bank accounts — including N26 Instant Savings — is protected up to €100,000 by the German Deposit Guarantee Scheme.

product_type.quote: Earn interest on your savings — calculated daily and paid out monthly.

rate_percent.quote: from 11/06/2025 onwards, 0.30% p.a. for Standard and Smart, 0.50% p.a. for N26 Go, and 1.50% p.a. for Metal (before taxes)

rate_type.quote: Yes, N26 may change interest rates at any time based on market fluctuation.

binding_months.quote: No need to lock your money away. Deposit and withdraw any amount, whenever you want.

withdrawals.quote: N26 Instant Savings is a fully flexible, easy-access savings account, so there are no penalties for withdrawing part — or all — of your funds before the end of the month.

withdrawal_terms.value: Fritt uttag när som helst utan avgift, ingen bindningstid. Ränta utbetalas ej på uttagna belopp.
withdrawal_terms.quote: In the event of withdrawal, no interest will be paid on the amounts withdrawn.

min_deposit_sek.quote: Add as much money as you like and earn interest on every cent.

deposit_terms.value: Engångs- och löpande insättningar tillåtna i valfri summa, ingen månadsinsättning krävs.
deposit_terms.quote: You may deposit as much money as you like into your savings account: you’ll earn interest on the total balance of your Instant Savings account.

eligibility.value: Kräver N26-bankkonto (personligt eller företag), tysk IBAN och bosatt i Belgien, Estland, Finland, Grekland, Irland, Lettland, Litauen, Luxemburg, Nederländerna, Portugal, Slovakien eller Slovenien. Sverige ingår ej.
eligibility.quote: To create a savings account, customers need to have an N26 personal or business bank account, German IBAN, and T&Cs, and legal residence in one of the following countries: Belgium, Estonia, Finland, Greece, Ireland, Latvia, Lithuania, Luxembourg, the Netherlands, Portugal, Slovakia, and Slovenia.

requires_other_products.quote: First, you’ll need to open an N26 bank account and select your membership — Standard, Smart, N26 Go, or Metal.

interest_paid.value: Månadsvis, bokförs första dagen i nästa månad
interest_paid.quote: The gross interest you earn is automatically calculated and paid into your Instant Savings account on the first day of the following month.

guarantee_country.quote: The money in your bank accounts — including N26 Instant Savings — is protected up to €100,000 by the German Deposit Guarantee Scheme.

guarantee_amount.quote: The money in your bank accounts — including N26 Instant Savings — is protected up to €100,000 by the German Deposit Guarantee Scheme.

rate_valid_from.quote: from 11/06/2025 onwards, 0.30% p.a. for Standard and Smart, 0.50% p.a. for N26 Go, and 1.50% p.a. for Metal (before taxes)

extraction.notes: Endast en produkt (N26 Instant Savings i EUR) hittades. Räntan varierar per N26-abonnemang: 0,30 % för Standard/Smart (använd som huvudvärde), 0,50 % för Go, 1,50 % för Metal. Kontot står inte uttryckligen markerat som EUR i källan utan valutan är härledd från €-beloppen. Kontot är inte tillgängligt för personer bosatta i Sverige enligt källan. Datumet 11/06/2025 är tolkat som 11 juni 2025. Flexible Cash Fund är en fond och ingår inte.
